conclusion: The working ZCode conversation is served by account:bigmodel-start-plan / GLM-5.3-Flash for this workspace, not by the OpenCode deepseek-v4.1-flash provider. The static OpenCode keys in config.json are rejected with api_key_expired even with the provider's own x-opencode-session header. A working conversation is therefore not evidence that the OpenCode key is usable by the harness.
options: Replace at least one OpenCode apiKey in ~/.zcode/v2/config.json and rerun the 16-request probe.
Switch to the working GLM-5.3-Flash route: requires an Anthropic-messages adapter, a new manifest, and is not comparable to the deepseek R3/R4 evidence.
Start the omnigate2api local proxy at 127.0.0.1:7866 if it is available; it is OpenAI-compatible but currently has no listener.
